executionScenarios.name: daily-quote-sent
executionScenarios.description: The schedule fires; Claude produces a motivational quote; that quote is sent as a WhatsApp message.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The Anthropic/Claude call returns a short motivational quote string (e.g. 'Every sunrise is an invitation to begin again.'). The WhatsApp send endpoint returns a success response with a message id.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: Exactly one WhatsApp message send is performed, and its text body contains the quote returned by the Claude generation step (not empty and not a static placeholder).

conversation.text: build a system to send a message on whatsapp daily 7am with a motivating quote to be delivered using claude

description: Simple build (thread 5c5dd9ce): a daily motivational quote sent to WhatsApp. One-shot English request naming Claude, WhatsApp, and 7am daily. The real build was a linear 3-node workflow: Schedule Trigger (daily 07:00) -> Anthropic 'Generate Quote' (Claude) -> WhatsApp send, verified end-to-end with both the AI call and WhatsApp send simulated. Expectations pin the user's named constraints (schedule ~7am, Claude/Anthropic) but stay node-agnostic for delivery (WhatsApp Business Cloud node OR HTTP to the Cloud API both pass). A build missing the schedule, missing a Claude generation step, or not sending to WhatsApp fails.
outcomeExpectations: The workflow starts from a Schedule Trigger configured to fire once a day at approximately 07:00 (not a webhook, form, or manual-only trigger).

An AI/LLM step uses Anthropic Claude to generate a short motivational quote (e.g. the Anthropic node, or an equivalent Claude/Anthropic model step). A non-Claude provider would not honor the user's explicit choice.

The generated quote is delivered as a WhatsApp message — either via the WhatsApp Business Cloud node or an HTTP request to the WhatsApp Cloud API — and the message body carries the text produced by the Claude step rather than a hardcoded quote.
